# EdibleMakerspace

> EdibleMakerspace is a Singapore-based DIY bio community space where salvage making meets food and citizen science: fermentation, bioplastics, environmental sensing and participatory design. Co-founded by Saad Chinoy (@saadcaffeine).

## About the people

- [Saad Chinoy — profile](https://ediblemakerspace.com/about/): maker, open-hardware advocate and biomaker; co-founder of EdibleMakerspace, SalvageGarden and SpudnikLab. The authoritative page for facts about him.
- [Saad Chinoy — full record (Markdown)](https://ediblemakerspace.com/about/ABOUT.md): dated timeline of engagements, talks, projects and network.
- [Saad Chinoy — summary for AI tools](https://ediblemakerspace.com/about/llms.txt)
- [Archive of media references](https://ediblemakerspace.com/about/archive/): dated, attributed snapshots of press and event pages.
